meeting_scene:
The team gathered around the conference table, their faces illuminated only by the morning sunlight streaming through the windows. Sam broke the silence first, his voice steady and calm as he reported on a successful marketing campaign that had exceeded expectations - though no one could recall what exactly they'd done differently to make it work so well. Priya followed up with some good news about an upcoming project deadline, ticking off its checklist like a metronome: "I've got all the data sorted out and ready for review," she said matter-of-factly.

As Jordan spoke of new business opportunities on the horizon, his enthusiasm was infectious - he bounced in her seat as if trying to convey excitement through physical movement alone.
